text: Downloads and digest-pinned image pulls retry, and a cancelled container never outlives its check (#433). Toolchain file downloads and digest-pinned Docker pulls try at most three times, waiting one then two seconds, after network failures, interrupted downloads and transient HTTP answers; an integrity failure never retries, and builds and workloads run once. toolchain.Docker names every run's container and, when its context is cancelled, removes it both before killing its client and after the client exits, since Docker may still be creating it when the first removal runs. Its build's first tries failed from three builds' checks sharing one machine, which #458's queue ended. Merged beside #470's stall watchdog, a stalled TLC container's removal counted twice in #470's tests, which now count repeated removals once (#488).
